name: feature-workflow
description: A structured harness for delivering one feature at a time.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver one feature at a time with a structured, evidence-backed workflow.
interface.longDescription: Feature Delivery Harness turns a feature request into a repeatable, evidence-backed delivery workflow. It guides the one-time lifecycle of a feature: clarify intent, research the codebase, create an implementation plan, deliver in controlled phases, capture commit-bound verification evidence, run independent QA, update documentation, and prepare a pull request for human review. It leaves prioritization, team coordination, review, and merging with people and their existing tools.
defaultPrompt: Research this feature and create a grounded implementation brief.
Plan this approved feature into implementation tasks.
Run independent QA for the current feature branch.
